summary: Iteration 9 — Backend + frontend QA of (1) team_notifications lifecycle (task audience + sales legacy token) and (2) POST/DELETE /api/assignments crew scheduling, plus (3) frontend New-Project crew picker + validation and (4) task badge E2E (marketing view '2' + sales '9+' cap + owner has none). All 3 new pytest cases pass, all 19 regression sharing tests still pass, all frontend checks pass. DB fully cleaned.
critical_code_review_comments: Projects.jsx save() logic is correct: crew-picker checks `if (crew.length && !form.jobDate)` BEFORE attempting createRecord/createAssignmentApi, so leaving the date empty with crew picked shows the toast without hitting Airtable (verified). Good order.

Projects.jsx createdId state prevents duplicate Airtable project creation on 'Schedule anyway' retry — projId is reused after first successful createRecord. Not E2E tested (Airtable 503 in preview) but code path is straightforward and correct.
Layout.jsx badge polling: 60s interval + reload-on-role-change works via useEffect deps [role, isTeamRole]. Verified marketing badge appears immediately after role-switch (no 60s wait needed). Nice.

Layout.jsx seenMarks: localStorage key `hy_seen_{type}_{role}` is per-role — so switching between marketing/sales/crew doesn't cross-contaminate marks. Verified switching back to owner cleared badges (owner is not in isTeamRole).
server.py _team_notify uses $setOnInsert with key as dedupe → re-POST same audience does not create duplicate rows. Verified (crew still had exactly 1 item after 2nd POST).
server.py set_task_audience: when audience is removed, deletes team_notifications with matching keys — verified for both crew and marketing groups reset to 0.
server.py team_notifications endpoint: owner has no group in TASK_GROUP_FOR_ROLE → returns {items: []}. Verified.

Minor: `test_todo_blog_sharing.py::test_owner_sets_audience_filters_invalid_groups_and_sorts` and other audience-mutation tests clean up task_meta but NOT team_notifications inserted by the mutation. Left 2 orphan team_notifications after regression run this iteration (both cleaned up manually). Recommend adding `mongo_meta` fixture cleanup to also purge team_notifications for the record. Non-blocking.

ALL cleaned up — final DB scan: 0 recQA/recTEST rows in team_notifications, task_meta, or assignments. Pre-existing task_meta rows untouched (1 legit row remains, unchanged from iteration 8).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration9_notifications_assignments.py runs in ~4s with `-o addopts=` (skip xdist). Covers: (a) full task-audience lifecycle including dedupe, add-group, reset-to-empty, owner-empty; (b) sales legacy password-only token returns 200 for /api/team-notifications; (c) POST /api/assignments with crew:[{user_id, position:Driver}] returns resolved crew name + shows up in javante's /api/crew/my-jobs + DELETE cleans up. AIRTABLE_API_KEY still empty → the crew-picker save flow can only be validated up to the date-validation toast in the UI (Airtable createRecord would 503 otherwise, but the toast fires BEFORE Airtable is called so this works). Owner login is via username 'HaulYeahOwner' (case-insensitive) + password with keyboard.type(delay>=15ms). role-switch-select is shadcn — click trigger, then get_by_role('option', name='Marketing view'). team_notifications with $setOnInsert dedupe → re-posting same audience is safe. task_meta docs persist with audience=[] after reset — cleanup regex `^rec(QA|TEST)` if needed. Frontend badge count derives from notifItems.filter(n.created_at > seenMarks[type]) — visiting /tasks or /blog immediately updates localStorage `hy_seen_{type}_{role}` and setSeenMarks, so badge disappears without page reload.
